source_of_truth: The close-time ENFORCEMENT half of the Experience Readiness Gate (split 2026-06-15, D025; sibling typing plan = 2026-06-15-001 / 2a). This plan owns the deterministic consumer_outcome_gate, the activation rule, the block/advisory/noop posture matrix, consumer-cardinality enforcement, and structured deferral/disposition. It CONSUMES 2a's vocabulary (closed surface_class/evidence_class enums, consumer families, structured EvidenceRef fields, the typing rule + degraded checker) and MUST NOT lock until 2a is merged. The promise: a declared consumer-facing outcome on a product-class or consumer-journey-bearing plan cannot close unproven; enforcement is deterministic at close (not LLM-triage-dependent); product claims cannot dodge by omitting a flag or a journey.

user_journeys.name: close-time-enforcement-and-disposition
user_journeys.description: At plan close, declared consumer outcomes on product-class plans BLOCK unless satisfied, explicitly deferred, or operator-dispositioned; internal substrate plans warn. The failure mode 'plan completes even though the consumer outcome was not proven' is prevented.
acceptance_signals: the gate ACTIVATES via ANY of opt_in / a journey declaring consumer / product-class goal_type / product_metadata (opt_in is not the only path; product claims cannot dodge by omitting the flag). product_metadata is parsed from plan.md frontmatter delivery_class: a deterministic enum {product|migration|readiness|ux|consumer_facing} -> product-class (activates + block-eligible), {substrate|mechanical|infra|refactor} -> substrate (advisory only)

ANY consumer-journey-bearing plan blocks an unproven outcome regardless of opt_in; the advisory/warn path is ONLY a substrate plan opted-in with NO consumer journeys (D030 — resolves the round-3 activation/posture contradiction)
a product-class plan that declares NO consumer journey emits no_consumer_journey_declared (advisory) rather than silently passing (D031 — closes the no-journey dodge)
a product-class human journey closed with only API-test (or seeded-only, or typed-skip-only) evidence raises consumer_outcome_unproven AND blocks close
the same with a real consumer-surface capture -> no finding, close not blocked

a STRUCTURED non-goal deferral naming {journey, consumer} or a STRUCTURED consumer_outcome_dispositions[] record {journey, consumer, reason, dispositioned_by, at} allows close (prose alone does not); a substrate plan with the same gap warns rather than blocks

consumer=both requires both families proven, with the not_yet_typed carve-out (D035): a TYPED-but-unsatisfied family OR a missing/unproven ENFORCED AGENT family -> consumer_outcome_unproven (blocks unless structurally deferred or dispositioned); a required HUMAN family that is not_yet_typed (2a-core D060 — no structured evidence at all) -> consumer_outcome_pending (advisory, the platform-level human-typing deferral; NOT unproven, no explicit non_goal required)

close requires >=1 real (non-seeded) end-to-end journey EXECUTION per objective claim per declared consumer; a required_data_source honestly degraded (availability=unavailable) WITHIN a real journey still satisfies (only entirely seeded / substrate-only / typed-skip-only journeys fail)

required_evidence: enforcement tests: posture matrix, product-class block on substrate/seeded/typed-skip-only, real-capture pass, defer/disposition allows close, substrate-plan warn (F005)
non_goals: the TYPING/EVIDENCE layer (surface_class/evidence_class/consumer/data_source/availability schema, typing rule, agent harness, degraded checker) — sibling plan 2a (2026-06-15-001); this plan CONSUMES it
the QuantRE Product Readiness plan (separate consumer-side plan)
completion_test: One feature passes: completion_gate.close_plan invokes a DETERMINISTIC pre-flip consumer_outcome_gate that, for activated plans (opt_in OR consumer-journey OR product-class/metadata), blocks the active->completed flip on an unproven consumer outcome independent of the codex F0 triage; consumer=both requires both families; deferral/disposition are structured; a substrate plan opted-in with no journeys warns; a product-class plan with no declared consumer journey emits no_consumer_journey_declared. Consumes 2a's vocabulary; does not re-define it.
